content: R cli-style print/format pattern: format.Cls <- function(x,...) cli_format_method({...}); print.Cls uses cat(format(x,...), sep='\n'). cli provides cli_h1(), cli_text(), cli_ul(), inline {.pkg}, {.url}, {.code} markup. rlang::abort() creates classed conditions; class= sets a hierarchy for tryCatch. local_use_cli() in .onLoad makes abort() format messages via cli. Condition classes: stop() -> abort(message, class='pkg_error_foo', ...) for catchable errors. Existing EventStudy code uses cat() in print methods and bare stop()/warning() — not yet cli/rlang classed.
